Mill Creek and Tributaries.source: Michigan DNR Trout Trails / Status of the Fishery Resource PDF TT2015087
Mill Creek and Tributaries.notes: DNR Trout Trails PDF for Mill Creek Flaherty Park describes a Type 1 trout stream with stocked/wild Brown Trout, wild Steelhead (Rainbow Trout), and occasional Chinook/Coho Salmon moving in from the Paw Paw River. PDF: https://www.dnr.state.mi.us/publications/pdfs/ArcGISOnline/StoryMaps/fish_troutTrails/PDFs/TT2015087.pdf

Boyle Lake.notes: Fishbrain lists top species as Largemouth Bass, Black Crappie, Bluegill; logged catches also include Yellow Perch and Redear Sunfish. URL: https://fishbrain.com/fishing-waters/c93m5HwA/boyle-lake

Coveney Lake.source: Generalized southwest Michigan warmwater lake assemblage
Coveney Lake.notes: No waterbody-specific species source (DNR report, stocking record, or named catch database) was found for Coveney Lake. Species list inferred from typical Berrien County small-lake fish communities.

Deer Creek.source: Generalized southwest Michigan warmwater creek assemblage
Deer Creek.notes: No waterbody-specific species source was found for Deer Creek (South Branch Galien River tributary). Nearby South Branch Galien River supports trout, but Deer Creek itself is unverified.
